messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "your prescriber might reduce your dose of insulin or sulphonylureas if needed to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia"
set: ["your prescriber might reduce your dose of insulin or sulphonylureas if needed to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia", "drink plenty of fluids to reduce risk of dehydration", "reduce dose if not tolerated", "starting dose and escalation schedule designed to reduce risk of gastrointestinal side effects", "reduce dosage if drowsiness develops", "gradually reduce dosage", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "drink 8 to 10 full glasses of fluid every day to reduce risk of kidney stones", "may reduce dose after adding diuretic", "use the lowest dose for the shortest amount of time needed to treat your condition", "reduce salt in diet", "do not change your dose or stop taking it without talking to your prescriber first", "doctor may reduce dose as condition improves", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "take with meals to reduce side effects", "do not change your dose or stop taking any of your medications without your doctor's advice"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
